hero.subtitle: An immersive interactive experience where the audience shapes the story through live voting.
hero.desc: Experience the game like never before. Your phone becomes part of the show, guiding the players through a branching narrative of choices and consequences.
story.title: An Island of Survival
story.desc: A gripping tale of choices, consequences, and the human spirit.
story.p1: On a remote island, far from civilization, a group of strangers find themselves drawn together by fate. They have chosen to participate in an extraordinary experiment — a game where every decision matters, where the line between trust and betrayal blurs with each passing moment.
story.p2: This is not just a performance. It is a living, breathing story that evolves with every vote. The audience becomes the director, choosing the paths that shape the destiny of the players on stage. Will they choose joy or sorrow? Triumph or mystery? Every choice creates a new reality.
story.p3: Inspired by the classic tension of survival games, this show blends classical ballet movements with dramatic, combat-style choreography to create a unique theatrical experience that has never been seen before in Egypt.
story.highlight1.title: First of Its Kind
story.highlight1.desc: The first interactive audience-driven show in Egypt
story.highlight2.title: Live Video Switching
story.highlight2.desc: Your votes trigger real-time video projections on stage
